If you're looking for a dynamic environment where you'll be supported with exceptional mentorship and resources to grow your career, come build with us.
The Role
As a DevOps Engineer at Apptegy, you will play an essential role in building, maintaining, and improving the infrastructure that supports our growing suite of products. You’ll work closely with software engineers to ensure our systems are scalable, reliable, and secure, while driving continuous improvement in our deployment and monitoring processes.
You’ll be part of a collaborative and fast-paced environment where you’ll automate workflows, optimize CI/CD pipelines, and contribute to the stability and performance of our cloud infrastructure. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and is eager to make a measurable impact on how we build and deliver software.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment and testing processes.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure infrastructure and application reliability, scalability, and security. Assess the balance between cost and performance.
  • Automate repetitive tasks and operational workflows to increase efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure in AWS using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Implement and monitor observability tools, ensuring system performance and availability.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues, providing quick resolutions to minimize downtime.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Infrastructure Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of cloud environments, preferably AWS, including EC2, RDS, S3, and related services.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or CircleCI.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or Ruby for automation and tooling.
  • Understanding of networking, security, WAF, and system performance principles.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with a focus on reliability and continuous improvement.
    • At Apptegy, we value skills and experience. For the majority of our roles, equivalent professional experience may be accepted in place of a higher education degree.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as AppSignal, Grafana, or Prometheus.
  • Exposure to software development environments using Ruby on Rails or similar frameworks.
  • Experience improving deployment reliability and reducing time-to-ship through automation.
  • Strong curiosity about emerging DevOps and cloud technologies and how they can improve developer experience.
  • Experience using or integrating with LLMs or LLM frameworks (LiteLLM, AWS Bedrock).
Why Apptegy
Join a team that’s committed to your success. At Apptegy, we’re passionate about creating an environment where you can do your best work and find true fulfillment. Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage
Retirement 401(k) with employer match
Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
Mental Health Reimbursement
Unlimited paid time off, including seasonal (December) company-wide time off

  • Autonomía para gestionar tu territorio y construir relaciones estratégicas con clientes.

En Ecolab, priorizamos el talento creando equipos diversos y altamente capacitados que operan en casi tres millones de sitios en más de 170 países. Con más de 48.000 personas, ofrecemos soluciones científicas, datos y servicio de excelencia para mejorar la seguridad alimentaria, la higiene, el uso eficiente del agua y energía, y la sostenibilidad. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Job Duties:

raw.description:
Job Summary

Hargrove is currently hiring a licensed Professional Electrical Engineer (PE) with deep experience in high-voltage substation systems to join our growing team. This role focuses on the physical design, analysis, and execution of electrical substations up to 345kV, supporting projects from conceptual planning through construction and commissioning. The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, leadership capability, and a commitment to quality, safety, and mentoring junior engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform physical design of electrical substations in accordance with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements, including:

    • General arrangement drawings

    • Equipment, electrical, and control building layouts

    • Elevation views

    • Cable trench design

    • Equipment grounding and ground grids

    • Lightning protection systems

    • Conduit and cable tray drawings

    • AC and DC power systems

    • Area lighting systems

    • Bills of Materials

  • Perform electrical calculations, studies, and analysis, including:

    • Touch and step voltage analysis

    • Substation grounding calculations

    • Pre- and post-energization harmonic studies

    • Short circuit studies

    • Mechanical force calculations on bus bars due to fault currents

    • Load flow and reactive power flow analysis

    • Harmonic filter analysis

    • NERC compliance analysis

    • Protective relay coordination

    • Transient analysis

    • Slack-span calculations for transmission line spans

    • Corona performance studies

  • Develop equipment and material specifications for outdoor switchyard equipment with operating voltages up to 345kV

  • Create procurement specifications and design scopes for engineered electrical equipment, including:

    • Vacuum and SF₆ circuit breakers

    • Motor-operated and gang-operated manual switches

    • Potential transformers (PTs) and current transformers (CTs)

    • Station service transformers

    • Insulators and surge arresters

    • Station service battery systems

  • Review, integrate, and manage vendor drawings and technical data

  • Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely and quality delivery of drawings, materials, and equipment per project schedules

  • Complete conceptual and preliminary designs for planning and estimating purposes

  • Prepare supporting documentation for procurement, construction, and operations/maintenance activities

  • Participate in and/or lead client meetings and job site visits to gather and communicate engineering data

  • Follow Hargrove’s QA/QC program to ensure compliance across all design packages

  • Mentor and support the development of less experienced engineers and designers in substation design

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license required

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in substation physical design

  • Proven experience with high-voltage systems up to 345kV

  • Strong document management, organization, and quality control skills

  • Exceptional attention to detail

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Software Experience

Candidates should have working knowledge of, or experience with, the following tools:

  • AutoCAD and/or AutoCAD Electrical

  • Bentley MicroStation

  • ETAP, SKM PowerTools, or ASPEN OneLiner

  • CYMCAP

  • PLS-CADD (or similar transmission line analysis software)

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit, stand, or walk for long periods of time.

Hargrove Culture

We work to create an environment founded on trust, personal integrity, and a “team mentality” so that each person understands the value of their contributions both on a project and company-wide level. We know that each person on our team contributes to the success of our company by pairing expertise and passion to meet and exceed the needs of the clients we serve across the globe.

Our safety culture protects and promotes the well-being of every person who works with us and every person touched by our work.

As a 100% Teammate owned company, we proudly offer a comprehensive benefits package including, paid holidays, personal paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, 401(k), and other benefits to eligible Teammates.

Equal Opportunity Employment Statement

Hargrove is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex (including gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sexual identity, marital or family status), disability, military service or obligations, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

As Senior Marketing Manager, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening our brand presence and driving market visibility with a particular focus on Account Based Marketing for key strategic accounts. You will translate complex, high-impact technology into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with decision-makers across enterprise, industrial, and data center segments.

This role shall be performed remotely within the United States.

Tasks

  • Develop and execute data-driven, multi-channel Account Based Marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, and qualified pipeline growth across Enterprise, Industrial, and Data Center segments.
  • Create, manage, and optimize high-quality marketing content, including case studies, blog posts, whitepapers, website content, and social media assets tailored to strategic segments.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead events and trade shows as a central element of demand generation and account engagement.
  • Monitor campaign performance using analytics, optimize initiatives, and report on ROI and pipeline impact.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to align marketing activities with business objectives and complex buying processes.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure consistent brand positioning and messaging across all channels.
  • Contribute hands-on within the Marketing & Sales team while helping shape strategic marketing priorities and processes.

Requirements

  • Proven experience developing and executing marketing and Account Based Marketing strategies, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or data-driven environments.
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. marketing landscape, including digital marketing, content marketing, SEO, PPC, and social media platforms.
  • Native-level English communication and copywriting skills, with experience addressing U.S.-based strategic audience segments.
  • Data-driven mindset with hands-on experience using marketing analytics/automation tools / CRM Systems such as Google Analytics, HubSpot, or comparable platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan and execute events as part of strategic demand generation.
  • Ability to combine creative storytelling with performance-oriented, measurable marketing outcomes.
  • Foundational knowledge of AI tools and their effective use in modern marketing workflows.
  • Eligibility to work remotely within the United State

Benefits

Compensation

Benefits

  • Purpose & impact: Help industrial companies become more energy-efficient and sustainable.
  • Flexibility: Fully remote role within the United States.
  • Team & culture: Collaborative, international team with open communication and short decision paths.
  • Retirement Plan: 401(k) retirement plan available to employees.

This gives you full flexibility in choosing your own insurance plan. We plan to transition to a traditional group health insurance plan as our U.S. team grows
  • Paid Time Off / PTO: Enjoy 20 days of vacation per year, along with paid sick leave (5 days) and recognized public holidays in accordance with state regulations.

What does a successful Sales Representative / Business Consultant do at Fiserv? ​
Revolutionize Commerce. Empower Businesses. Define Your Career.​

​Are you ready to be a game-changer? At Fiserv, we're transforming the way businesses operate and grow. You will be on the frontlines of innovation, connecting small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) with Clover, our award-winning point-of-sale and business management platform. Join a dynamic team that thrives on passion, purpose, and performance.​

​Why Choose Fiserv? We don’t just deliver technology; we create solutions that redefine commerce. With Clover, we’ve built a trusted platform that’s powering over 700,000 merchants worldwide and processed over $330 billion in card transactions in 2024.​

​We’re not here to simply sell; we’re here to empower businesses with tools to succeed. As the world’s largest merchant acquirer, you’ll have the resources, reputation, and technology to make a real difference.​

​Your career at Fiserv isn’t just about closing deals—it’s about opening doors to possibility.​

​What you will do: ​
Be the Catalyst for Growth: Travel across the assigned territory, partnering with Financial Institutions to bring Clover’s cutting-edge solutions to merchants, sparking success wherever you go.​

Turn Leads Into Legacy: Proactively generate leads and expand your portfolio in a fast-paced, business-to-business environment. Leverage Fiserv’s extensive partnerships and referral networks to fuel your pipeline.​

Consult. Solve. Transform: Act as a strategic advisor to merchants, tailoring solutions that help them grow, adapt, and thrive in a competitive marketplace.​

Elevate Excellence: Embody Fiserv’s core values by fostering authentic connections and maintaining the highest ethical standards. ​

​

What you will need to have: ​

  • High School Diploma/GED

  • Experience in a quota-driven, self-sourcing sales environment

  • Demonstrated success in cold-calling and generating your own leads

​

What would be great to have: ​

  • Bachelor’s degree or military experience

  • 3+ years of sales experience, particularly in consultative and relationship-driven roles

  • Proven ability to design strategies that drive pipeline growth and revenue
